% Generated by scripts/render_pivdata_examples.py; do not hand edit.
All exchanges use PD address 0x01 and CRC-16. Each request table gives the field values; the packet bytes below it show how those values are encoded.

\href{run:worked-examples/pivdata/examples.json}{Complete machine-readable exchanges} include every frame. \href{run:worked-examples/pivdata/manifest.json}{The fixture manifest} records the inputs, expected results, source locations, and hashes. Hex includes the OSDP header and CRC, without an optional leading mark byte. Long replies show their first 0x18 and last 0x10 bytes; ellipsis text is not transmitted.

\subsection{Complete Discovery Object}\label{ex:pivdata-discovery-whole}
Read the complete Discovery Object. Tag Length 0x00 keeps its outer tag 0x7E and its length, followed by all its contents.

Example ID: \texttt{discovery-whole}.
Source: \hyperref[pivdata-source-S1]{S1}.

\begin{SimpleTable}{Request fields}{3}
  {|L{0.30\SimpleUsableWidth}|L{0.27\SimpleUsableWidth}|L{0.43\SimpleUsableWidth}|}
  {\TableHeaderCell{Field} & \TableHeaderCell{Value} & \TableHeaderCell{Notes}}
Command & \texttt{0xA3} & \texttt{osdp\_PIVGETDATA} \\\hline
Identifier Length & \texttt{0x01} & Bytes in Object Identifier. \\\hline
Object Identifier & \texttt{0x7E} & Object to read. \\\hline
Tag Length & \texttt{0x00} & Select the whole object. \\\hline
Element Tag & Omitted & Tag Length is zero. \\\hline
Offset & \texttt{0x0000} & Start at the selected tag. \\\hline
Requested Length & \texttt{0x0000} & All remaining bytes. \\\hline
\end{SimpleTable}

Result: \texttt{0x0014} returned bytes in \texttt{0x01} data reply.

\Needspace{28\baselineskip}
\subsection{Read a range within the certificate element}\label{ex:pivdata-certificate-offset256}
Read 0x0104 bytes starting at offset 0x0100 of the certificate element, counting from tag 0x70. The reply offsets are 0x0000, 0x0072, and 0x00E4; each identifies a position within the 0x0104 returned bytes.

Example ID: \texttt{certificate-offset256}.
Source: \hyperref[pivdata-source-S1]{S1}.

\begin{SimpleTable}{Request fields}{3}
  {|L{0.30\SimpleUsableWidth}|L{0.27\SimpleUsableWidth}|L{0.43\SimpleUsableWidth}|}

Command & \texttt{0xA3} & \texttt{osdp\_PIVGETDATA} \\\hline
Identifier Length & \texttt{0x03} & Bytes in Object Identifier. \\\hline
Object Identifier & \texttt{0x5FC105} & Object to read. \\\hline
Tag Length & \texttt{0x01} & Bytes in Element Tag. \\\hline
Element Tag & \texttt{0x70} & Element to select. \\\hline
Offset & \texttt{0x0100} & Bytes to skip from the selected tag. \\\hline
Requested Length & \texttt{0x0104} & Maximum bytes to return. \\\hline
\end{SimpleTable}

Result: \texttt{0x0104} returned bytes in \texttt{0x03} data replies.
